messages.subject: Multigroup and multi level analysis
parts:
Hello all, 
I have questions concerning lavaan to fit my model. My dataset consists of ~1000 data points and 500 respondents living in 38 clusters (vilid). Each respondent was interviewed twice. 
I am interested to see how the paths change between survey rounds, so I apply Multigroup MSEM, grouping by survey rounds (dummy = 0 , 1). 

My code is: 
mod1 <- 'group: 0
            level: within
            diet_ind ~ crop_ind + ma_food + inctrl
           
            level: between
            crop_ind ~ sa + crop_com
           
        group: 1
            level: within
            diet_ind ~ crop_ind + ma_food + inc_vi + ploti
           
            level: between
            crop_ind ~ sa + crop_com + diet_com
            '
fit1<- sem(model=mod1, data=semall, cluster="vilid", group="round", fixed.x=FALSE, std.lv=TRUE, h1=TRUE)

However, I received the warning "Error in lavsamplestats@cov[[g]][cbind(row.idx, col.idx)] : subscript out of bounds"

Can you help me explain what happened?
Thank you.
